title: PR Account Manager - inhouse or agency welcome!
company: Moxie and Mettle Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
PR Account Manager - looking into interview ASAP! Send your CV quickly as interviews are taking place!

Cirencester

£32k-40k + benefits

Ready for your next PR move?

We're working with a lovely, established communications agency that's looking for a PR Account Manager to join its collaborative and supportive team.

You'll work across a varied portfolio of clients and sectors, managing campaigns, building relationships and creating PR that gets people talking.

Whether your experience is agency or client-side, we're open to hearing from you. You'll need to be comfortable juggling multiple campaigns, managing budgets and turning complex information into engaging stories.

What you'll be doing
- Managing client relationships and delivering brilliant PR campaigns.
- Developing creative ideas and securing great media coverage.
- Writing press releases, features and engaging content.
- Managing multiple projects, deadlines and budgets.
- Providing strategic advice and supporting junior team members.

What we're looking for
- Previous PR or communications experience, agency or client-side.
- Experience managing multiple campaigns and budgets.
- Excellent writing and communication skills.
- A creative mind and a knack for finding a great story.
- Ambition to grow and progress your PR career.

Why you'll love it

A genuinely supportive and collaborative team.

Clear progression and development opportunities over the next 12-18 months.

Hybrid working - 3 days in the office, 2 from home.

Flexible start times, from 8am-4pm to 10am-6pm.

A varied portfolio of clients and sectors.

Sound like your kind of role?

Get in touch with Moxie & Mettle for a confidential chat or apply today.

We'd love to hear from you.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
What's in it for you?
- Performance-related bonus
- Company pension
- Collaborative and supportive office environment
- Opportunity to shape product strategy and contribute to business growth on an international scale
- Exposure to multiple markets and channels across the UK, Europe, and North America

Must have's
- Experience in product marketing, marketing, brand management, or a similar commercial role
- Strong commercial awareness and analytical skills
- Experience supporting or delivering product launches and marketing campaigns
- Excellent project management and organisational abilities
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
- Ability to interpret data, identify opportunities, and turn insights into action
- Confident working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, operations, suppliers, and customers

Nice to have's
- Degree or qualification in Marketing, Business, Product Management, or a related field
- Experience working across international markets
- Knowledge of B2 B, B2 C, or D2 C environments

So, what will you be doing?
- Managing products throughout the full product life cycle
- Developing product strategies, road maps, and growth plans
- Conducting market, customer, and competitor research
- Creating product positioning, messaging, and value propositions
- Leading product launches and go-to-market activities
- Monitoring product performance and identifying opportunities for improvement
- Maintaining accurate product information, specifications, and internal data
- Supporting the development and launch of new products
- Building business cases for new product opportunities
- Collaborating with suppliers, operations teams, and sales teams to bring products to market
- Managing launch timelines and coordinating cross-functional delivery
- Tracking market trends, customer needs, and emerging technologies
- Partnering with sales teams to drive revenue growth
- Creating product training materials, sales tools, and customer-facing content
- Providing product expertise and market insights to internal stakeholders
- Analysing sales and market performance data to support decision-making
- Supporting marketing campaigns, exhibitions, events, demonstrations, and training activities
- Ensuring consistent product messaging and brand positioning
- Measuring product launch success and return on investment
- Producing performance reports and recommendations to improve results
- Identifying opportunities to enhance customer engagement and sales performance

Helpful extras
- Experience working in a product-led business
- Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery
- Comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities simultaneously

Interested? Send your CV to i 2i Recruitment today! Our mission of 'Making Recruitment Personal' also means making recruitment fair. As a result, we are committed to reviewing every application with a sense of diversity and inclusion. We strive to personally connect with each applicant, but due to the number of applications we receive, this is not always possible. We will still aim to update you on your application, regardless of if it's successful.
